# `description-length`

**Tool rule** · `warning` · on by default

Descriptions should be long enough to disambiguate and short enough to fit small model contexts.

A tool rule judges one tool from its own definition, so it runs everywhere: `lint()`, `lintTools()`, the CLI, the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler and the ESLint plugin.

## Options

| Option | Default |
| ------ | ------- |
| `min`  | `20`    |
| `max`  | `600`   |

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "description-length": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "description-length": "warning" } }); // change severity
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "description-length": { min: 20 } } });
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule description-length=off
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/description-length": "error" } }
```
